name: DescribeAuditLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to view the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to view the regions and zones, including the region IDs, that are supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You can query SQL audit logs only when SQL Audit is enabled. You can query only the SQL audit logs from the last 30 days. If you disable and then re-enable SQL Audit, you can query only the logs generated after it was re-enabled
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
仅当SQL审计状态为开启时，才能查询到SQL审计日志，且只支持查询30天内的SQL审计日志。如果中途关闭了SQL审计，再次打开时，仅能查询到再次打开后的SQL审计日志
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time.

The time range to query cannot exceed 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
查询开始时间与查询结束时间的间隔不能超过24小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database on which the SQL statement was executed
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the query. This keyword is used to filter SQL statements
parameters.help_zh: 对查询包含目标关键字的SQL进行查询
parameters.name: query_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement. Valid values:

DELETE

SELECT

UPDATE

INSERT_INTO_SELECT

ALTER

DROP

CREATE

You can query for only one type of SQL statement at a time. If you leave this parameter empty, all types of SQL statements are queried
parameters.help_zh:
SQL类型，取值：
DELETE
SELECT
UPDATE
INSERT_INTO_SELECT
ALTER
DROP
CREATE


每次仅允许传入一种类型查询，若该参数为空，默认查询所有类型
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the SQL statement was successfully executed. Valid values:

true: The SQL statement was successfully executed.

false: The SQL statement failed to be executed
parameters.help_zh:
目标SQL是否执行成功，取值说明：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
parameters.name: succeed

parameters.help_en: The IP address and port number of the client that was used to execute the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 执行目标SQL的客户端IP地址和端口号
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en:
The order by which to sort the query results based on the execution time of the SQL statement. Valid values:

asc: ascending.

desc: descending
parameters.help_zh:
按SQL执行时间进行正序或倒序排序，取值说明：
asc：正序。
desc：倒序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The username that was used to execute the SQL statement
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the query results. Specify the value as an ordered JSON array. The results are sorted based on the order of fields in the array. Each object in the array contains the \`Field\` and \`Type\` fields.

Field specifies the field by which to sort the query results. Valid values:

HostAddress: the IP address of the client that connects to the database.

Succeed: specifies whether the SQL statement was successfully executed.

TotalTime: the total amount of time that is consumed to execute the SQL statement.

DBName: the name of the database on which the SQL statement was executed.

SQLType: the type of the SQL statement.

User: the username that was used to execute the SQL statement.

ExecuteTime: the start time of the SQL statement execution.

Type specifies the sorting method. Valid values:

Desc: descending.

Asc: ascending
parameters.help_zh:
根据指定字段进行排序，格式为JSON，是一个有序JSON数组，按输入数组的顺序进行复合排序，包含Field和Type两个字段。
Field表示需要排序的字段名，取值说明：
    - HostAddress：连接数据库的客户端地址。
    - Succeed：目标SQL是否执行成功。
    - TotalTime：目标SQL的执行总耗时。
    - DBName：执行目标SQL的数据库名称。
    - SQLType：SQL类型。
    - User：执行目标SQL的用户名。
    - ExecuteTime：目标SQL的执行开始时间。
Type表示排序类型，取值说明：
    - Desc：降序。
    - Asc：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

10

30

50

100

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
10
30
50
100
本参数不填写时，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number
